snippet.title: Coin Smith | Official Trailer
snippet.description: It all starts with a hammer and a single coin. Buy a ruin, fix it up and keep swinging until there are mints floating past the stars. Then start over, faster this time. Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528140/Coin_Smith/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=update2026&utm_content=trailer #coinsmith #idlegame
